title: Marimekko survey composition
intent: Encode each survey question's response count as column width and its Likert composition as stacked height.

ai.create: Create a Marimekko chart from raw survey rows where question totals determine column widths and each question's response mix determines normalized vertical cells, using granular d3-array preparation and typed rectangle endpoints.
ai.maintain: Add a question or response while preserving the original Question and Response fields through counting, the two independent normalization denominators, explicit Likert ordering, stable cell identity, labels, colors, and complete zero-to-one bounds.
